mapper.select: SELECT MONTH(platform_created_at_moscow) as month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount_rub / 100), 0) as amount FROM erp_order WHERE YEAR(platform_created_at_moscow) = #{year} AND erp_status != 'CANCELED' AND total_amount_rub IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MONTH(platform_created_at_moscow)
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_order SET outbound_status = 'ALLOCATED', version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND outbound_status = 'NONE' AND fulfillment_order_id IS NULL AND outbound_order_id IS NULL

UPDATE erp_order SET outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND outbound_status = 'ALLOCATED' AND outbound_order_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM erp_order o INNER JOIN erp_order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN sku_mapping sm ON oi.platform_item_id = sm.platform_item_id WHERE o.erp_status = 'DELIVERED' AND o.platform_created_at >= #{startTime} AND sm.sku_code = #{skuCode}

sql.if: AND (o.warehouse_fulfillment_status IS NULL OR o.warehouse_fulfillment_status = '') AND COALESCE(o.erp_status, '') NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'CANCELLED', 'RETURNED')

AND (o.warehouse_fulfillment_status IN ('CANCEL_RETURNING', 'CANCELLED') OR ((o.warehouse_fulfillment_status IS NULL OR o.warehouse_fulfillment_status = '') AND o.erp_status IN ('CANCELED', 'CANCELLED', 'RETURNED')))
AND o.warehouse_name IS NOT NULL AND o.warehouse_name NOT LIKE '%大%'

AND ( o.platform_order_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.keyword}, '%') OR CAST(o.id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_order_item oi LEFT JOIN sku_mapping sm ON oi.platform_item_id = sm.platform_item_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND (oi.platform_item_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.keyword}, '%') OR sm.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{qo.keyword}, '%'))) )
